strongest_angle: The Health and Safety Executive's 2025/26 statistics reveal persistent workplace ill-health challenges in Great Britain, driven by stress and musculoskeletal disorders.

key_facts.fact: The Health and Safety Executive reported in its summary statistics that 1.8 million workers in Great Britain suffered from work-related ill health during 2025/26.
According to the Health and Safety Executive's 2025/26 summary statistics for Great Britain, 0.9 million workers suffered from work-related stress, depression, or anxiety.
The Health and Safety Executive recorded 0.5 million workers in Great Britain suffering from work-related musculoskeletal disorders in 2025/26.
The Health and Safety Executive Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26 documented 124 workers killed at work across Great Britain.
